judged_as: Deliberate 294 s long-form covering the full journey. Length and card-based sourcing are not penalised in themselves; 2-minute-plus retention was judged by whether each section earns its time.
strengths: The South Africa slip remains a strong, human first line, and the first 20 s now carry real pictures with no card.
s072 (dugout tears, 152.3 s) and s121 (wedding rings, 269.4 s) are the best sync points, each landing exactly on its line.
The dead middle is gone: card share is down from 41% to 31%, and 171 to 193 s no longer has a long card run.
s109 now reads as tears for most of the shot, so the climax no longer contradicts its words.
s095 puts him in Saudi dress on 'considered himself Saudi', a real payoff instead of a city aerial.
The ending loops to the press table with an earned last line. Cover art is strong and legible.

fixes.problem: Caption pages break inside numbers and names: 'IN NOVEMBER TWENTY / TWENTY-FIVE HE SAT' (202 s), 'IN MAY TWENTY / TWENTY-FIVE HE' (163 s), 'A RECORD NINE HUNDRED / FIFTY-SEVEN MILLION' (122 s), 'HOME WAS A FOUR / SEASONS SUITE' (96 s). In a video built on dates and sums these are the words a viewer most needs whole.
fixes.fix: In the split_phrase cost function, add cost +20 when a page ends on a number word (twenty, hundred, thousand and similar) and the next word is a number word or hyphenated number, and for the name pair 'Four Seasons'. No narration or timing change. This also affects other topics, so run it past the owner.

fixes.problem: Measured from final.mp4, the bed in speech gaps has a median of -31 dB against -14 dB for speech, about 17 dB under; STYLE 5 asks for about 12 dB. A sparse track that low may disappear on a phone speaker over five minutes. Inferred from levels, not heard, so a listener should confirm before accepting.
fixes.fix: Set music.gain_db to 3 and run the remix only, then check by ear. Revert if the bed competes with the voice.
